title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.31317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. We present SurveyGraph, a framework built around a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations. The graph supports core-paper discovery, retrieval, hybrid outlining, and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. We evaluate retrieval, semantic edges, citation grounding, collection coverage, and generation-stage components. In a controlled seven-method equal-budget benchmark, MEKG-anchored fusion balances recall and structural density, with an independent co-citation check. In a separate archived graph-native diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines across eight runs (p = 0.004). A semantic evidence gate achieves AUC = 0.75. Audits of 160 generated sentences find 80.6% anchored-or-partial citation support.

translated_title: SurveyGraph：基于方法-实体知识图谱生成学术综述
translated_abstract: 大多数自动化综述生成系统将论文作为扁平文档进行检索，限制了其捕捉研究结构的能力。我们提出SurveyGraph，一个围绕方法-实体知识图谱（MEKG）构建的框架，该图谱编码了方法层面的后续研究、竞争以及共享资源关系。该图谱支持核心论文发现、检索、混合大纲构建以及基于证据门控的叙事综合。我们评估了检索、语义边、引用依据、文献集覆盖率以及生成阶段组件。在一项受控的七种方法等预算基准测试中，以MEKG为锚点的融合方法在召回率与结构密度之间取得平衡，并通过独立的共被引检验加以验证。在另一项独立的存档图原生诊断中，图感知检索在八次运行中的召回率几乎是扁平词汇基线的两倍（p = 0.004）。语义证据门控达到AUC = 0.75。对160个生成句子的审计发现，80.6%的句子具有锚定或部分的引用支持。
tldr: SurveyGraph通过构建编码方法级后续、竞争与资源共享关系的“方法-实体知识图谱”（MEKG）来生成学术综述，使图感知检索的召回率相比扁平文本基线近乎翻倍，并显著提升了生成内容的引用支持率。
en_tdlr: SurveyGraph generates academic surveys via a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations, nearly doubling retrieval recall over flat baselines and achieving strong citation grounding in generated narratives.
